summary: Agent processed customer's request for annual fee waiver.

intents.keywords: हेलो मैं सुनील चौहान मेरे क्रेडिट कार्ड की वार्षिक फीस माफ ... क्यों नहीं हुई?

issues.reason(s): Minimum spending criteria not met for fee waiver offer.

intents.actions of agent: Agent checked the customer's account and confirmed the reason for the fee not being waived. Agent then submitted a request for a fee waiver.
intents.resolution: Agent submitted a request to waive the annual fee, which will be updated in 5-7 days.
